_readme.what: Baseline model catalog for the CLI provider types (claude/codex/gemini). Feeds the per-session model picker. Not used by the wick provider — that one has its own registry (see WickModels / internal/agents/provider/wick).
_readme.contract: internal/agents/provider/modelcatalog.go — modelCatalog{updated_at, providers} + modelEntry{id, desc, enabled, updated_at}. Unknown keys (like this one) are ignored by encoding/json, so keep decoration here, not inside a provider list.
_readme.id_is_a_cli_flag: An entry's `id` is passed verbatim as `--model <id>` to the provider binary (internal/agents/provider/modelargs.go). So it MUST be a name/alias that CLI accepts, not a display label. Wrong id = spawn dies. Aliases (opus, sonnet, haiku, fable) and full names (claude-opus-5) are both fine as long as the CLI takes them.
_readme.load_order: 3 layers of this same schema, merged per-model by id, newest `updated_at` wins: (1) EMBEDDED — this file, go:embed'd into the binary; (2) REMOTE — same path on master via raw.githubusercontent.com, fetched lazily behind a 6h TTL; (3) DISK — last successful remote fetch, cached under the app data dir as models.json and hand-editable to force a change without a release.
_readme.add_a_model: Append an entry to the right provider array with enabled=true and today's date as `updated_at`; bump the top-level `updated_at` too. Because merge is newest-wins per id, the date is what makes your change beat an older remote/disk copy — a stale date means the edit silently loses.
_readme.remove_a_model: Prefer `enabled: false` over deleting the entry (bump its `updated_at`): a deleted id can be resurrected by the remote/disk layer, a disabled one stays hidden because the flag merges too. Delete only when the id never shipped remotely.
_readme.propagation: Editing this file only affects builds that embed it. Live servers pick the change up from the remote layer once it lands on master (<=6h, or immediately via RefreshRemoteModels). Existing sessions keep whatever model they already pinned.
_readme.tests: internal/agents/provider/modelcatalog_test.go covers seeding + merge; modelargs_test.go covers the --model flag. Run: go test ./internal/agents/provider/...
